quests.title: Windrush Day
quests.summary: Read the plaques to the Empire Windrush and to Claudia Jones, and tell Marcia.

steps.text: Read the Empire Windrush plaque in London.
Read the plaque to Claudia Jones.

quests.reward: A Carnival Whistle and standing with England.

quests.title: The Seamen's Wives
quests.summary: Read the plaques to Liverpool's Chinese seamen and the Chinatown arch for Lily.

steps.text: Read the plaque to the Chinese seamen.
Read the plaque about the Chinatown arch.

quests.reward: A lai see envelope and standing with England.

quests.title: Stokers and Sailors
quests.summary: Read the Tiger Bay plaque and hear Mr Saleh out, for Amina.

steps.text: Read the Tiger Bay plaque in Cardiff.
Find Mr Saleh and hear about the Yemeni sailors.

quests.reward: A lump of Welsh steam coal and standing with Wales.

quests.title: The Emigrants' Road
quests.summary: Follow the Famine emigrants from Dublin to Liverpool and Cork, for Maura.

steps.text: Read the Famine Figures on Custom House Quay.
Read the plaque to Black '47 in Liverpool.
Read the plaque to Annie Moore in Cork.
Go back to Maura in Dublin.

quests.reward: A Steerage Ticket and standing with Ireland.
